messages:
tara: Heads-up: nightly SAST run flagged the keystore wrapper in runtime-agent. KMS decrypt is failing in CI. Anyone oncall?
sec-oncall-bot: Incident #823 created: sast-failure-keystore. Pinged eng-infra and sec.
oliver: I'm on it. Can you paste the failing log snippet?
tara: here's the short log: ```ERROR: kms.Decrypt: AccessDenied: permission denied for projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/agent-key``` CI job: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/1234
jamal: Likely IAM binding missing for the scanner service account. We rotated the keystore role last week. Minimal fix is granting roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
jamal: Example policy snippet: ```bindings:
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  members:
  - serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com```
emma: Agree. Also please enable audit logging on the key ring so we can capture attempted decrypts. Can infra add a log sink to the security project? :eyes:
jamal: Will add the sink. Quick question: do we want to temporarily suppress this SAST finding? It's blocking a bunch of PRs.
tara: Prefer not to blanket-suppress. Per our playbook, we fix the root cause and only allow suppression with security lead approval and an evidence entry.
oliver: For fast unblock I can apply a canary grant in staging and re-run the pipeline. I'll also add a small gating test so devs can run local decrypt checks.
devx: Suggested PR note for devs: 'Run `./scripts/ci/decrypt_test.sh` before pushing keystore-related changes' — I can add that to the docs and PR template.
emma: Action items: update SDLC checklist to include KMS role verification and add an automated CI check that validates decrypt permission (not just lint). Tagging @sec-lead for final approval on role change.
sec-oncall-bot: Runbook excerpt: if SAST fails with KMS decrypt errors -> (1) check IAM bindings for scanner service account, (2) check keyRing audit logs for denied calls, (3) apply minimal decrypt role in staging, (4) re-run SAST, (5) open PR with evidence and request security approval. Link: /runbooks/kms-decrypt
jamal: Done: applied temporary grant to staging keystore at 1712456900; logs show decrypt success. I'll schedule a permanent role update and add the log sink by EOD.
tara: :thumbsup: re-running the nightly SAST now.
oliver: SAST passed in staging after the grant. I'll open a small infra PR to apply the role to prod with the approval checklist.
emma: Great — once prod is updated, we'll close the incident and capture the change in the KB. I'll own the playbook update and SDLC checklist entry.
